title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13442v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parallel drafters accelerate LLM decoding by proposing a whole block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, making them attractive for LLM serving. Recent systems optimize goodput (i.e., accepted tokens per second) because rejected drafts steal compute from other requests. However, these systems control only how many tokens are verified, so every request still drafts a full block. At high serving load, we find that drafting consumes up to 40% of step time, of which a majority is discarded because it is never verified. Yet, draft-length control from autoregressive drafters does not carry over, because a parallel drafter commits to its length before its single pass. Moreover, draft and verification lengths are coupled across the batch, so they must be selected jointly for every request while keeping the decision computationally cheap at every step. translated_title: ForeSpark：面向并行投机解码的草稿与验证预算联合调度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.13442v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：并行草稿器通过在单次前向传播中提出一整块草稿token来加速LLM解码，使其对LLM服务具有很强的吸引力。近期的系统优化的是有效吞吐量（goodput，即每秒被接受的token数），因为被拒绝的草稿会抢占其他请求的计算资源。然而，这些系统只能控制验证多少个token，因此每个请求仍然会草稿出完整的一块token。在高服务负载下，我们发现草稿生成会消耗高达40%的步进时间，其中大部分因从未被验证而被丢弃。而且，来自自回归草稿器的草稿长度控制方式无法直接迁移到并行草稿器，因为并行草稿器必须在其唯一一次前向传播之前就确定其长度。此外，草稿长度与验证长度在整个批次中相互耦合，因此必须为每个请求联合选择这两者，同时保证该决策在每一步的计算开销都足够低。在本文中，我们提出节省工作的投机（WCS）设计，该设计联合分配……
tldr: 该论文提出工作保持投机解码（WCS），通过联合调度每个请求的草稿生成与验证预算，解决了并行投机解码中草稿计算大量浪费的问题，从而提升高负载下LLM服务的有效吞吐量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Work-Conserving Speculation (WCS), which jointly schedules draft and verification budgets per request to eliminate wasted draft computation and improve goodput in LLM serving under high load.
